blocks.x: National digital government builds shared rails — identity, data exchange, notification, payments — and industrializes citizen services on top. Success is measured in take-up, resolution and trust; failure modes are silos, legacy cores and unaccountable AI.

The workflows we industrialize here: Citizen service delivery, Benefits/licensing casework, Interagency data exchange, Fraud/error control, Records management. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.
